manifest.scope: Same current candidate implementation/source snapshot compiled by frozen main baseline and isolated word parameter capture emitters. Records the exact current rebased compiler source catalog; unrelated main runtime modules are included only if that catalog loads them.

semantics.scope: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V4 instruction/cycle and user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.
